1151: ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ; ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Fear and doubt are dispelled in an instant
when the transcendent Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
The Lord, Ram Ram, is ever the help of the saints.
ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At home and abroad the transcendent Lord is with them; He fully pervades all places. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Lord of the world is their wealth, property, youth and way of life;
He ever cherishes their soul and breath with peace.
ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ; ਦੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
He gives His hand and protects His servant;
ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥ ॥੨॥
He does not forsake him even for an instant; He is ever with him. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
There is no beloved like the Lord;
the True One takes care of all.
The Lord is mother, father, son and relative;
from the beginning and through the ages, the devotees sing His praises. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
His support and God's strength are in their minds;
without the One there is no other.
In Nanak's mind is this courage:
my God resolves all my affairs. ॥4॥38॥51॥
ਭੈ ਕਉ. ਭਉ ਪੜਿਆ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Fear itself is afraid of one who remembers the Lord's Name.
ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟੀ. ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ; ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All the diseases of the three qualities are erased; the affairs of the Lord's servant are fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ. ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਾਮ ॥
The Lord's people ever sing His praises; they have found the perfect home.
ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ. ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
Even the Righteous Judge, the Messenger of Death, longs day and night for the sight of His servant, to be sanctified. ॥1॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
Lust, anger, greed, intoxication, slander and pride are erased in the company of the holy.
ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਹਿ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੫੨॥
By great fortune one meets such saints; Nanak is ever a sacrifice to them. ॥2॥39॥52॥
He is a worshipper of the five pirs who keeps the five within;
he rises each day and speaks lies with his tongue.
He marks his body with ritual symbols and practises hypocrisy;
ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਪਚੈ; ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਡ ॥੧॥
he wastes away in grief like a widow. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਸਭ ਝੂਠੁ ॥
Without the Lord's Name, all is false.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ. ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ. ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਠੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the perfect Guru liberation is not obtained; in the True Court the faithless are plundered. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He alone is filthy who does not recognise the Creator in His creation.
ਲੀਪਿਐ ਥਾਇ; ਨ ਸੁਚਿ, ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
By plastering a cooking square the Lord does not accept one as pure.
One whose inner self is filthy and who washes his outer body daily
loses his honour in the True Court. ॥2॥
For the sake of Maya he makes efforts,
but never places his foot on the straight path.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਣੈ ॥
He does not remember the One who created him;
he speaks only falsehood with his mouth. ॥3॥
One upon whom the Creator bestows His grace
deals in the company of the holy.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
He loves the Lord's Name and devotion;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ. ਨਹੀ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੩॥
says Nanak, that servant suffers no loss. ॥4॥40॥53॥
False are the dealings of the slanderer.
Filthy is the conduct of the slanderer.
The Lord is the protector of His servant. ॥1॥
The slanderer dies along with other slanderers.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ; ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ. ਕੜਕਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The transcendent Lord protects His servants; Death thunders over the slanderer's head. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1152: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
No one believes what the slanderer says;
the slanderers tell lies and then repent.
They wring their hands and beat their heads on the ground;
the Lord does not let the slanderer go. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ. ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
The Lord's servant wishes no one ill,
yet the slanderer suffers pain as if pierced by a spear.
Like a heron, he spreads out his feathers to look like a swan;
ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਿਆ; ਤਾਂ ਕਢਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
but when he speaks with his mouth, he is found out and driven away. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
What the Lord's servant does is permanent.
The Lord's servant is true in His court;
servant Nanak speaks, having reflected on the essence. ॥4॥41॥54॥
With palms joined, I offer my prayer;
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
my soul, body and wealth are His capital.
He is my Master, the Creator;
millions of times I am a sacrifice to Him. ॥1॥
The dust of the holy has purified me.
ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering God, the vices of the mind are erased, and the filth of countless lifetimes is removed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ; ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
In His home are all treasures;
He is the support of the soul and breath of His devotees. ॥2॥
He illumines each and every heart, all of them;
His devotees live by chanting and chanting the treasure of virtue.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Service to Him does not go in vain;
within mind and body, meditate on the One. ॥3॥
Through the Guru's teaching come compassion and contentment,
and the treasure of the Name — this pure thing.
Be merciful and attach me to Your hem;
may Nanak ever meditate on Your lotus feet. ॥4॥42॥55॥
My True Guru has heard my prayer;
all my affairs have been resolved.
Within mind and body I meditate on God;
the perfect Guru has dispelled all my fear. ॥1॥
The divine Guru is the greatest and most powerful of all;
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
serving Him, I have obtained all peace. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
He by whose doing everything happens —
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਮਰੁ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
no one can erase His command.
The transcendent Lord is incomparably beautiful;
ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
His image is fruitful; the Guru is His form. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
One within whom the Lord's Name dwells —
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ; ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
whatever he sees is divine wisdom.
ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
One whose mind is fully illumined —
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
within that servant the transcendent Lord dwells. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
I bow forever to that Guru;
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਜਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
I wash the feet of the True Guru and drink the water;
ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੬॥
Nanak, meditating on the Guru, I live forever. ॥4॥43॥56॥
1153: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਪਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ; ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਨੀ ॥
O merciful God, Cherisher of all, which of Your virtues can I count?
ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ. ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ; ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Countless are Your colours and many Your waves; You are the Master of all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਗਿਆਨ. ਅਨਿਕ ਧਿਆਨ; ਅਨਿਕ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ॥
Countless are the wisdoms, countless the meditations, countless the chants and austerities;
ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨਿਤ. ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ; ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
countless the virtues contemplated, the sweet melodies sung, countless the silent sages. ॥1॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਜ; ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ; ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ. ਅਨਿਕ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ, ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
Countless sounds and countless instruments, countless delights each moment; countless sins and diseases are erased by hearing Your praise.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ. ਤਟਹ ਖਟਹ, ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ; ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ. ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਨ, ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
Nanak, serving the infinite divine Lord brings the fruit of pilgrimages to sacred banks, the six Shastras, fasts and worship, wanderings and journeys — all fruits and merit. ॥2॥1॥57॥8॥21॥7॥57॥93॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ. ਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ; ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord; this is realised through the Guru's teaching.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ. ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ; ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ. ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Through the Word one recognises the nectar Word; pain is cut away and ego is subdued. ॥1॥
Nanak, the disease of ego is so terrible.
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ. ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wherever I look, I see the same pain; the Primal Lord Himself forgives through the Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ. ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
When the Appraiser Himself appraises one, one is not tested again.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ. ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Those blessed with His glance are united by the Guru; what pleases God is true. ॥2॥
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ; ਰੋਗੀ. ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
Air, water and fire are diseased; diseased is the earth with all its enjoyments.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ, ਸਿ ਰੋਗੀ; ਰੋਗੀ. ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; diseased are those bound up with family. ॥3॥
ਰੋਗੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦ੍ਰਾ; ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.
ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ. ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Those who recognise the Lord's state and reflect on the Guru's Word are liberated. ॥4॥
ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਨਦੀਆ; ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
The seven seas and the rivers are diseased; the continents and nether regions are full of disease.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ. ਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
The Lord's people dwell in Truth and are at peace; He blesses them with His glance everywhere. ॥5॥
ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ; ਨਾਨਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
The six schools in their religious garbs are diseased, and the many kinds of ascetics.
ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ; ਨਹ ਬੂਝਹਿ. ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
What can the Vedas and Semitic scriptures do for them? They do not understand the One. ॥6॥
ਮਿਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ. ਸੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ; ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
One who eats sweet delicacies is filled with disease; one who lives on roots and tubers finds no peace either.
ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
Forgetting the Name, they walk other paths, and at the end they repent. ॥7॥
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ; ਪੜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Wandering to pilgrimage places the disease is not cured; the learned are caught in disputes and arguments.
ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ. ਸੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਵਡੇਰਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੮॥
The disease of duality is the greatest of all; it makes one dependent on Maya. ॥8॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
One who as Guru-facing praises the True One through the Word, with the True One in the mind — his disease is gone.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ, ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥੧॥
Nanak, the Lord's servants are pure night and day; by His grace they bear His insignia. ॥9॥1॥
1154: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Creator has staged a wondrous play.
He has made the unstruck Word, the Shabad, heard.
The self-willed are misled; the Guru-facing understand.
The Creator has always created the causes. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
The Guru's Word is my inner meditation.
ਹਉ ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I shall never forsake the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Prahlad's father sent him to school to study.
Taking his tablet, he came to the teacher.
"Without the Name I will not study anything else.
ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Write on my tablet the Name of the Lord of the universe, the Destroyer of demons." ॥2॥
His mother said to her son Prahlad,
"Do not study what you are absorbed in" — she tried and tried to persuade him.
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
"The fearless Giver, the dear Lord, is with me.
ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਉ; ਤਉ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
If I forsook the Lord, my family would be disgraced." ॥3॥
ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕਹਿਆ. ਨ ਸੁਣੈ; ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
He does not listen to us; he does his own thing.
He has instilled devotion throughout the whole city."
ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਕਾ; ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
The gathering of the wicked could do nothing against him. ॥4॥
Sanda and Marka complained to the king.
All the demons tried their utmost in vain.
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
He preserves the honour of His devotees;
what can anyone He has created do? ॥5॥
Because of past deeds, the demon ruled the kingdom.
ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
He did not understand the Lord; the Lord Himself had misled him.
He started a quarrel with his son Prahlad;
ਅੰਧਾ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ; ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੬॥
the blind man did not see that his death was near. ॥6॥
ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਕੋਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਬਾਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
Prahlad was locked in a room, and the door was padlocked.
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ. ਮੂਲਿ, ਨ ਡਰਈ; ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
The fearless child was not afraid at all: "Within me is the Guru, the Lord of the world."
ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸਰੀਕੀ ਕਰੈ; ਅਨਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
A created being who tries to rival the Creator takes on a name without substance.
ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ. ਸੋੁ ਆਇ ਪਹੁਤਾ; ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
What was written from the start came to pass; he started a quarrel with the Lord's servant. ॥7॥
The father raised his club at Prahlad:
"Where is your Lord of the universe, your Master?"
"The Life of the world, the Giver, is our helper in the end.
Wherever I look, I see Him pervading." ॥8॥
Tearing the pillar apart, the Lord revealed Himself.
The arrogant demon was killed and destroyed.
The minds of the devotees were filled with bliss, and congratulations poured in.
He blessed His servant with glory. ॥9॥
He created birth, death and attachment;
the Creator has ordained coming and going.
ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਜਿ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
For Prahlad's sake, the Lord revealed Himself;
the word of the devotees came true. ॥10॥
ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲੀ; ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕਉ, ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
The gods proclaimed the victory of Lakshmi:
"O mother, make Him put away the form of the Man-Lion!"
ਲਖਿਮੀ ਭਉ ਕਰੈ; ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Lakshmi was afraid and could not approach.
1155: Prahlad, the humble servant, came and fell at His feet. ॥11॥
The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Name within.
Kingdom, property and all Maya are false.
The greedy remain clinging to them;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
without the Lord's Name they are punished in His court. ॥12॥
ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak, everyone acts as He makes them act.
ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
They alone are approved who focus their awareness on the Lord.
He has always taken the side of His devotees;
the Creator has revealed His own form. ॥13॥1॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Serving the Guru, I obtained the nectar fruit; my ego and craving are quenched.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
The Lord's Name dwells in my heart and mind, and the mind's desires are absorbed in the mind. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Dear Lord, my Beloved, please be merciful.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ. ਦੀਨ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Night and day Your meek servant begs for Your praises; save me through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ. ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ, ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ. ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
Death cannot even look at the saints; not the slightest heat of pain touches them.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ; ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Those in Your sanctuary are saved and save all their generations. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ; ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
You Yourself preserve the honour of Your devotees; this is Your glory.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਹਿ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
You cut away the sins and pains of countless lifetimes; not even a speck of duality remains. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
We are foolish and ignorant and understand nothing; You Yourself give understanding.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
Whatever pleases You, that alone one does; nothing else can be done. ॥4॥
ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ. ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ; ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Creating the world, You attached it to its tasks; it does evil deeds.
ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ. ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ; ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
It has lost the treasure of this life in gambling, and has not grasped awareness of the Word. ॥5॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
The self-willed die understanding nothing; they are in the darkness of evil intellect and ignorance.
ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਬ ਹੀ; ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ, ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
They never cross the terrifying ocean; without the Guru they drown and die with heavy loads on their heads. ॥6॥
ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Those imbued with the True Word are true; the Lord God Himself unites them.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤੀ; ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Through the Word they recognise the Guru's Word, and remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ॥7॥
ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
You Yourself are pure, and pure are Your servants who reflect on the Guru's Word.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ॥8॥2॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is the greatest king.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has all affairs resolved.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has obtained millions in wealth.
Without the Name, life passes in vain. ॥1॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
I praise one who has the Lord's wealth as capital;
ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
very fortunate is one on whose forehead the Guru has placed His hand. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਟ ਕਈ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has many forts and armies.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart enjoys peace and poise.
1156: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is cooled and soothed.
Without the Name, life is cursed and one is dead. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is liberated while alive.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart knows every right way of living.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has obtained the nine treasures.
Without the Name, one wanders in doubt, coming and going. ॥3॥
One with the Name in the heart is carefree.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart always earns a profit.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has a great family.
Without the Name, one is a self-willed fool. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has an unshakeable seat.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਨੁ ॥
One with the Name in the heart sits upon the throne.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is the true banker.
One without the Name has no honour or credit. ॥5॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is known among all.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is the image of the Creator.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is the highest of all.
Without the Name, one wanders in countless reincarnations. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪਹਾਰਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has his creation made manifest.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
One with the Name in the heart has his darkness dispelled.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
One with the Name in the heart is approved.
Without the Name, one comes and goes again. ॥7॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
He alone obtains the Name to whom the Lord is merciful;
in the company of the holy he beholds the Lord of the world.
His comings and goings cease, and he finds peace;
says Nanak, his essence merges in the Essence. ॥8॥1॥4॥
He created millions of incarnations of Vishnu;
millions of universes are His places of righteousness;
He creates and absorbs millions of Shivas;
He has set millions of Brahmas to fashioning the worlds. ॥1॥
Such is my Master, the Lord of the universe;
ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot describe the expanse of His virtues. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Millions of Mayas are His handmaidens;
millions of beings are His couch;
millions of creations are part of You;
millions of devotees dwell with the Lord. ॥2॥
Millions of emperors bow before Him;
millions of Indras stand at His door;
ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
millions of heavens are within His glance;
ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
millions are His Names; His worth cannot be estimated. ॥3॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ ॥
Millions of celestial sounds resound for Him;
millions are His arenas and wondrous plays;
millions of Shivas and Shaktis obey His command;
He gives support to millions of beings. ॥4॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
Millions of pilgrimage places are at His feet;
millions become pure chanting His beautiful Name;
millions are His expanses; there is no other. ॥5॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸ ॥
Millions of pure swan-souls sing His glory;
ਕੋਟਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਸ ॥
millions of the sons of Brahma praise Him;
millions of creations and destructions happen in an instant;
ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ; ਗਣੇ. ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
millions are Your virtues; they cannot be counted. ॥6॥
Millions of the wise speak of His wisdom;
millions of meditators focus their meditation;
millions of great ascetics practise austerity;
1157: millions of great sages dwell in silence. ॥7॥
The unseen Master, the unfathomable Lord,
Wherever I look, I see Your dwelling;
The True Guru has given me this gift:
He has given me the priceless jewel of the Lord's Name.
Now there is endless delight and wonder in poise;
Nanak has met God, the Remover of anxiety. ॥1॥
Says Nanak, true is the praise of the Lord;
ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
again and again, my mind is absorbed in it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The love of the Carefree Lord is my food;
the Name of the Carefree Lord is taken within me;
through the Word of the Carefree Lord I am saved;
the treasures of the Carefree Lord are full within me. ॥2॥
Through the Carefree Lord my affairs are fulfilled;
through the Carefree Lord my sorrows are gone;
through the Carefree Lord enemies have become friends;
ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
through the Carefree Lord I have brought this mind under control. ॥3॥
The Carefree Lord has comforted me;
through the Carefree Lord my hopes are fulfilled;
the Carefree Lord is for me the essence of all teachings;
ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
the Guru has given me the mantra of the Carefree Lord. ॥4॥
Through the Carefree Lord my enmities are destroyed;
through the Carefree Lord my darkness is dispelled;
through the Carefree Lord His praise is sweet to my mind;
ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੫॥
through the Carefree Lord I have seen God in each and every heart. ॥5॥
Through the Carefree Lord all my doubt is erased;
the Carefree Lord dwells in my mind, a home of peace and rest;
the unstruck melody of the Carefree Lord resounds within me;
the Carefree Lord of the universe thunders within me. ॥6॥
Through the Carefree Lord my mind is satisfied;
I have recognised the Carefree Lord, the unshakeable Master;
through the Carefree Lord all discernment has welled up;
ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਰੀ ਹਥਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥੭॥
the staff of the Carefree Lord is in my hand; the Lord, Har Har, is my support. ॥7॥
God, the Carefree One, wrote this destiny from the start;
the Carefree Lord, the one Master, has met me.
Through the Carefree Lord all anxiety is gone;
Nanak, Nanak, Nanak is absorbed in God. ॥8॥3॥6॥
ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
This wealth of mine is the Lord's Name.
ਗਾਂਠਿ. ਨ ਬਾਧਉ; ਬੇਚਿ. ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I do not tie it in a knot, nor sell it to make my living. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਖੇਤੀ; ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
The Name is my farm; the Name is my garden.
Your humble servant performs devotion and seeks Your sanctuary. ॥1॥
ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ; ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
The Name is my Maya; the Name is my capital.
Forsaking You, I know no other. ॥2॥
ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਿਪ; ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
The Name is my family; the Name is my brother.
ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
The Name is my companion, who will help me in the end. ॥3॥
One whom He keeps detached amid Maya —
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
says Kabir, I am his slave. ॥4॥1॥
Naked we come, and naked we go.
No one, not even kings and nobles, will remain. ॥1॥
1158: The sovereign Lord is my nine treasures.
ਸੰਪੈ ਹੇਤੁ; ਕਲਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wealth, attachment, spouse and riches are your support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
That which comes with us at birth does not go along at death.
What does it matter if elephants are tethered at your door? ॥2॥
The fortress of Lanka was made of gold,
but what could foolish Ravan take with him? ॥3॥
Says Kabir, reflect on some good deeds;
in the end, the gambler departs empty-handed. ॥4॥2॥
Brahma is filthy, Indra is filthy;
the sun is filthy, and the moon is filthy. ॥1॥
This world is polluted with filth;
ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
only the Lord is pure, who has no end or limit. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The rulers of universes are filthy;
filthy are the nights and days and the thirty days of the month. ॥2॥
The pearl is filthy, the diamond is filthy;
wind, fire and water are filthy. ॥3॥
Shiva, Shankara and Mahesh are filthy;
the Siddhas, seekers and wearers of religious garb are filthy. ॥4॥
The Yogis, Jangams and those with matted hair are filthy;
the body is filthy, along with the soul-swan. ॥5॥
Says Kabir, those humble beings are approved
and pure, who know the Lord. ॥6॥3॥
ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਕਾ; ਕਿਬਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Make your mind the Mecca and your body the Kaaba;
the Speaker within is the supreme Guru. ॥1॥
O Mullah, utter the call to prayer;
the one mosque of the body has ten doors. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Slaughter your anger, doubt and malice;
consume the five, and you shall find contentment. ॥2॥
Hindus and Muslims have the same one Master;
ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਮੁਲਾਂ; ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੇਖ ॥੩॥
what can the Mullah do, what can the Shaikh do? ॥3॥
Says Kabir, I have gone mad;
slaying, slaying my mind, it has merged in poise. ॥4॥4॥
Mingling with the Ganges, a stream is "spoiled";
that stream becomes the Ganges itself and is fulfilled. ॥1॥
Kabir has been "spoiled" by proclaiming the Lord;
ਸਾਚੁ ਭਇਓ; ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he has become true and goes nowhere else. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Beside the sandalwood, a tree is "spoiled";
that tree becomes sandalwood itself and is fulfilled. ॥2॥
Touching the philosopher's stone, copper is "spoiled";
that copper becomes gold and is fulfilled. ॥3॥
In the company of the saints, Kabir is "spoiled";
that Kabir has become one with the Lord. ॥4॥5॥
Some mark their foreheads, carry rosaries in hand and wear religious robes;
people think the Lord is a plaything. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਹਉ ਬਉਰਾ; ਤਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
If I am insane, I am Yours, O Lord;
ਲੋਗੁ. ਮਰਮੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
how can people know my secret? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੋਰਉ. ਨ ਪਾਤੀ; ਪੂਜਉ. ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
I do not pick leaves in offering, nor worship idols;
without devotion to the Lord, service is useless. ॥2॥
I worship the True Guru; forever and ever I please Him;
through such service I find peace in the Lord's court. ॥3॥
People say Kabir has gone insane;
only the Lord knows Kabir's secret. ॥4॥6॥
Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both caste and lineage;
my weaving is now in the deep stillness of poise. ॥1॥
I have no quarrel with anyone;
1159: I have forsaken both the pandits and the mullahs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I weave and weave, and wear what I weave;
ਜਹ ਨਹੀ ਆਪੁ; ਤਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
where there is no ego, there I sing His praises. ॥2॥
Whatever the pandits and mullahs have written,
ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ; ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
I have left behind; I have taken none of it. ॥3॥
With sincere love in the heart, behold the Lord;
searching and searching the self, Kabir has met Him. ॥4॥7॥
No one shows respect to the poor man.
ਲਾਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ; ਓਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਧਰੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He may make thousands of efforts, but no one pays him any attention. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the poor man goes to a rich man,
the rich man sits there and turns his back. ॥1॥
But when the rich man goes to the poor man,
the poor man welcomes him with respect. ॥2॥
The poor man and the rich man are both brothers;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ; ਨ ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Says Kabir, he alone is poor
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
who does not have the Name in his heart. ॥4॥8॥
When one earns devotion through serving the Guru,
then this human body is truly obtained.
Even the gods long for this human body;
ਸੋ ਦੇਹੀ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
so with that body, meditate on the Lord and serve Him. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Lord of the universe, and never forget Him;
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ; ਏਹੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
this is the profit of human birth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
As long as the disease of old age has not come,
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀ ਨਹੀ. ਕਾਇਆ ॥
as long as death has not seized the body,
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
as long as your voice has not become feeble,
meditate, O mind, on the Lord of the world. ॥2॥
ਅਬ. ਨ ਭਜਸਿ; ਭਜਸਿ ਕਬ ਭਾਈ ॥
If you do not meditate now, when will you, O brother?
When the end comes, you will not be able to meditate.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਅਬ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Whatever you have to do, do it now;
otherwise you will repent, and you will not find the far shore. ॥3॥
He alone is a servant whom the Lord attaches to His service;
he alone obtains the immaculate divine Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
Meeting the Guru, his shutters are opened,
and he does not have to travel the path of reincarnation again. ॥4॥
ਇਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ; ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰ ॥
This is your chance, and this is your time;
look within your own heart and reflect on it.
I have told you in so many ways, proclaiming it again and again. ॥5॥1॥9॥
ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ; ਬਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
In the city of Shiva, the Lord of bliss, dwells sublime understanding;
ਤਹ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ; ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
meet Him there and reflect on Him.
One comes to understand this world and the next;
ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ; ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
why die over deeds done saying "mine, mine"? ॥1॥
My meditation is focused on my own true home;
ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੋਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Name of the sovereign Lord is my divine wisdom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At the root door I have built a dam;
I have held the moon above the sun.
The sun blazes at the western gate;
the central channel rises up above my head. ॥2॥
There is a stone at that western gate,
and above that stone is another window;
above that window is the tenth gate.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਤਾ ਕਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
Says Kabir, it has no end or limit. ॥3॥2॥10॥
ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾਂ; ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰੈ ॥
He alone is a mullah who struggles with his mind,
and through the Guru's teaching wrestles with death,
crushing the pride of the Messenger of Death;
to that mullah I ever offer greetings. ॥1॥
1160: God is ever present; why do you say He is far away?
Bind your clamouring passions, and find the Beautiful Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He alone is a qazi who reflects on the body,
and through the fire within the body is illumined by God;
who does not lose his seed even in dreams;
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਜੀ ਕਉ; ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
for that qazi there is no old age or death. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ; ਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੈ ॥
He alone is a sultan who shoots two arrows,
brings back the mind that wanders outside,
and gathers his army in the realm of the tenth gate;
that sultan bears the royal canopy over his head. ॥3॥
the Hindu utters the Name of Ram;
the Muslim has only his one God;
Those who call a stone their god —
Those who fall at the feet of a stone —
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God gives His gifts to all beings. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The divine Lord is within, but the blind one does not know;
deluded by doubt, he is caught in the noose.
ਨ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਬੋਲੈ; ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
The stone does not speak, nor give anything;
such rituals are useless, such service fruitless. ॥2॥
If a corpse is anointed with sandalwood,
ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ; ਕਵਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
tell me, what good does it do?
ਜੇ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੁਲਾਈ ॥
And if a corpse is rolled in filth,
ਤਾਂ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਾ; ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Says Kabir, I proclaim this aloud:
understand and see, you faithless fool —
love of duality has ruined so many homes;
the Lord's devotees are ever at peace. ॥4॥4॥12॥
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਮੀਨ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
The fish in the water is attached to Maya;
the moth fluttering at the lamp is pierced by Maya;
the lust of Maya afflicts the elephant;
snakes and bumblebees are destroyed through Maya. ॥1॥
Such are the enticements of Maya, O brother;
as many beings as there are, it has deceived them all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Birds and deer are imbued with Maya;
sugar is a deadly trap for flies;
horses and camels are absorbed in Maya;
the eighty-four Siddhas play in Maya. ॥2॥
The six celibates are slaves of Maya,
as are the nine masters of yoga, the sun and the moon;
the austere disciplinarians and the rishis are asleep in Maya;
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ; ਕਾਲੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
death and the five demons are in Maya. ॥3॥
Dogs and jackals are imbued with Maya,
trees and roots are planted in Maya. ॥4॥
Even the gods are drenched with Maya,
as are the oceans, the heavens and the earth.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਸੁ ਉਦਰੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Says Kabir, whoever has a belly to fill is under the spell of Maya;
one is released only on finding the Holy One. ॥5॥5॥13॥
As long as one cries "mine, mine,"
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਕਾਜੁ ਏਕੁ. ਨਹੀ ਸਰੈ ॥
not a single task is accomplished.
